text.autoconfig.radiuscrafting.title: Radius Crafting Settings
text.autoconfig.radiuscrafting.option.se: How many blocks away to search for nearby chests and barrels.
text.autoconfig.radiuscrafting.option.us: If enabled, items will be pulled from your Ender Chest.
If enabled, items will be pulled from Shulker Boxes in your inventory and Ender Chest.
